stories.title: Release the Cursed Drider
stories.summary: Deliver the golden engraved dragon statue to release the cursed drider. Local statue exchanges provide a preparation route; a valid statue from another source also works.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a golden engraved dragon statue
steps.hint: The local two-statue exchange can prepare this item. Another valid statue also works.
Return to the request giver with the exact offering.
